title: Asymptotic stability of shear flows for 2D Euler equations at Yudovich regularity
summary: The nonlinear asymptotic stability of shear flows in the 2D Euler equations has traditionally been linked to inviscid damping in the periodic setting. Since Gevrey regularity is required to suppress the ``echo'' phenomenon, asymptotic stability is known to be impossible in Sobolev spaces. In this paper, we identify a distinct stabilizing mechanism available in the infinite channel: the advection of vorticity to spatial infinity.
